functions.spec: Actual mating surface for 14.6 x 3 mm ring
Actual mating surface for 14.6 x 3 mm ring

method: Actual width-aware 2D segment capsule footprints at real model bead bottom Z; support top Z and gap measured from emitted model bead, adjacent-model support distinguished; only <=4mm screw-hole bridge at <=30mm/s is an explicit short-span exception.
criterion: At least75% of sparse source-probe points require real nearby model footprint and no modeled downward probe may have unexplained support/bridge span. This is a finite digital ROI check, not full-area finish or physical acceptance.
